recipe.build:
sed -ri '/signingConfigs.getBy/d' src-tauri/gen/android/app/build.gradle.kts
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_PATH}" -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin"
export NDK_HOME="$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}"
npm install --global corepack@latest
corepack enable pnpm
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
rustup target add aarch64-linux-android
export SABLE_FOSS=1
export VITE_APP_VERSION=${APP_TAG#v}
export VITE_IS_RELEASE_TAG=true
PROJECT_ROOT="$PWD"
CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}"
RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}"
export RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS:+$RUSTFLAGS} --remap-path-prefix=$PROJECT_ROOT=/usr/src/sable --remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_HOME=/usr/local/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$RUSTUP_HOME=/usr/local/rustup"
node .github/scripts/set-tauri-version.mjs "$VITE_APP_VERSION"
rm src-tauri/capabilities/geolocation.json
pnpm tauri android build --apk --split-per-abi --target aarch64 -- --no-default-features --features wry,matrix-crypto
find . -name '*.apk'
mv src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/arm64/release/app-arm64-release*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
